name: Local media generation
summary: Makes pictures, sound and video on this machine with ComfyUI, starting it if it is not already running, so the media-making half of Combined mode is real.

requires.why: To talk to ComfyUI, which is running on this machine and listening on a local port.
To save the pictures it makes. They are deleted when you delete this plugin.
To start ComfyUI for you, if it is installed on this machine and not already running.
To download one image model, if this machine has none. It is kept in this plugin’s folder.
To read the workflow file you exported from ComfyUI, so it can be saved where ComfyUI keeps them. It only ever reads.

settings.label: ComfyUI address
settings.hint: Where ComfyUI is listening. Leave it as it is unless you started it on another port.

settings.label: Where ComfyUI is installed
settings.hint: The folder with main.py in it. Leave it empty and Alexia looks in the usual places.

settings.label: Start ComfyUI when a picture is asked for
settings.hint: It takes about a minute the first time and stays running afterwards. Off means you start it yourself.

settings.label: Model
settings.hint: Any part of a checkpoint’s filename is enough — typing hassaku finds hassakuXLIllustrious_v22. Leave it empty for whichever ComfyUI has. Ask Alexia to list the models to see the names.

settings.label: Steps
settings.hint: More steps is slower and usually better, up to a point. Twenty-five suits SDXL.

settings.label: Use the full-precision VAE
settings.hint: SDXL's half-precision VAE produces black images on many 8 GB cards. On costs a little VRAM and avoids that.

widgets.label: Made here
widgets.hint: Everything this machine has made, newest first. Nothing is ever deleted to make room — the size below is what that costs. Click one to see what made it.

widgets.label: Workflow library
widgets.hint: The workflows ComfyUI ships, filtered to the ones this graphics card can actually run and that need no paid service. Press Install and run_workflow can use it. The two ranked tiers the plan describes — workflows Alexia has verified, and a curated set — do not exist yet, and a badge for them would mean nothing.

widgets.label: Workflows
widgets.hint: The ComfyUI workflows on this machine — the ones Alexia installed for you and the ones you exported yourself. Removing one deletes it from ComfyUI’s own folder, because that is where it lives.
